dish.note: Cold king prawns with lemon aioli and buttered white bread.
dish.how: Beat 150g mayonnaise with 2 crushed garlic cloves, the zest and juice of 1 lemon and a pinch of salt. Pile 1.2kg cooked king prawns on a platter over ice with lemon wedges, and serve with the aioli and 8 slices of buttered white bread. Peel as you go.

steps.text: Beat the mayonnaise with the garlic, lemon zest and juice.
Butter the bread and cut into triangles.
Pile the prawns on a platter with the lemon wedges and serve with the aioli.

dish.make_ahead: Make the aioli up to 1 day ahead and keep the prawns cold

veg.n: Asparagus with lemon aioli and buttered bread (vegetarian)

steps.text: Beat the mayonnaise with the garlic, lemon zest and juice.
Blanch the asparagus for 3 minutes in boiling salted water, then cool in iced water.
Butter the bread and cut into triangles.
Pile the asparagus on a platter with lemon wedges and serve with the aioli.

veg.make_ahead: Make the aioli up to 1 day ahead and keep the asparagus chilled

dish.vegNote: Blanched asparagus spears with the same aioli
